DevOps

DevOps
Streamline your Development Workflow with our DevOps Expertise
Market Cloud empowers you to achieve continuous delivery and operational excellence with our robust DevOps services. We leverage a combination of industry-leading tools and methodologies to automate your software development lifecycle, ensuring faster deployments, improved reliability, and reduced operational costs. Our team of DevOps specialists can help you implement a customized DevOps strategy that seamlessly integrates with your development and deployment processes.
Essential Cloud & Automation Tools
Microsoft Azure
Leverage the scalability and security of Microsoft's cloud platform for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Jenkins
A popular open-source automation server, Jenkins allows for the creation of automated build, test, and deployment pipelines.
Docker
Package your applications with Docker containers for consistent and isolated deployments across different environments.
Kubernetes
Orchestrates and manages containerized applications at scale with the power and flexibility of Kubernetes.
GitHub
Utilize GitHub for version control, collaboration, and seamless integration with your CI/CD pipelines.
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Tap into the vast array of AWS services for building and managing your DevOps infrastructure on the cloud.
Elastic Stack (ELK)
Gain valuable insights into your infrastructure performance and application health with the comprehensive monitoring and logging capabilities of ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).

Our Services
Docker

BladeCenter

VMware

Streamlined DevOps Process
Market Cloud implements a DevOps process that focuses on
Continuous Integration & Delivery (CI/CD)
Automate code building, testing, and deployments to ensure frequent and reliable releases.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Manage your infrastructure configuration in code for consistency and repeatability.
Continuous Monitoring
Gain real-time insights into your applications and infrastructure performance to identify and resolve issues proactively.
Hire Your DevOps Engineer With Us
Build a high-performing DevOps team with Market Cloud. We connect you with skilled DevOps professionals who possess the expertise to implement and manage your DevOps infrastructure effectively.
